background: Belfius is a Belgian retail, public-sector and insurance group wholly owned by the Belgian state, funded by Belgian retail deposits and lending to households, companies and Belgian local authorities.
synthesis: Ratings are A on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of them on 21 Apr 2026. Capital is strong, with CET1 of 16.2% and leverage of 6.2% both above their peer medians; liquidity is adequate rather than strong, LCR of 145% below the median against NSFR of 129% above it. Little has moved: leverage is down 0.4 points since 30 Jun 2024 and the other ratios are broadly flat (figures to 31 Mar 2026). Both flagged items, the newer on 10 Aug 2026, concern the same cyber-security technology launch rather than anything bearing on credit.
